test_intent: A/B test whether in-process telemetry is required to reproduce the GPU.0 hang.

hypothesis_result.hypothesis: In-process telemetry collection is required to trigger the GPU.0 hang.
hypothesis_result.reason: The hang reproduced while worker telemetry was disabled and telemetry was collected only by the parent supervisor.

supported_conclusions: GPU.0 FP32 produced correct finite outputs through the last completed inference.
The monolithic stability worker can hang even without in-process telemetry.
The external supervisor detected the stall and recovered control by terminating the exact child PID.
The prior in-process telemetry explanation is no longer supported.
unsupported_conclusions: This experiment does not identify the exact root cause inside OpenVINO, the Intel GPU plugin, the driver, file I/O, or the Python harness.
This experiment does not prove that external telemetry causes or prevents the hang.
This five-minute failed diagnostic is not a stability acceptance run.

remaining_boundary.failing_path: The monolithic stability worker performs inference, correctness checks, latency bookkeeping, and per-inference CSV handling in one process.
remaining_boundary.previously_successful_path: The guarded diagnostic used a minimal inference child and parent-side heartbeat logging for five minutes.
remaining_boundary.interpretation: The trigger lies in one of the remaining path differences or is intermittent; further isolation or an explicit isolated-worker architecture decision is required.
